verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is documented as a visual automation builder that runs sequences of automated blocks from event triggers such as "when a new deal is created." Those runs can include AI agent steps (web research, scoring, routing), workflows can be built just by describing the goal, and the SDK adds custom triggers and steps that call external APIs during a run. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled or recurring triggers, run history and monitoring for background executions, documented limits or reliability guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party marketing and docs.
